decision_history.reason: Sound great-trade thesis at the wrong moment, weaker than RKLB-early-2024 on the sharpened bar; primary and adversarial agree. Firewall CLEAR (no new financing/guidance-cut/credibility/runway event since the 06-07 deep dive; ~$6.57 Jun-6 vs $6.67 signal, entry live; twiist/AID still qualitative, no units). FAILS the RKLB-grade conjunction: inflection NOT present across discriminators (0-of-4 cleanly present; only the MECHANICAL Ascensia-rev-share margin leg SHOWN; load-bearing twiist/AID growth leg ASSERTED-not-shown; OCF adverse — absences land where the thesis needs them, the round-tripper tell). Theme MID-stage (HUNT P3, neutral regime, capital flowing out) in a ~98%-locked duopoly, SENS the ~1% challenger. Re-rate-magnitude catalyst 12-18mo UNDATED; evidence-backed reward today ~2x, ≥4x in a P=0.12 tail; ~25-30% permanent-impairment from chronic dilution (survivable, not ruin). Theme-map inflection-STRONG keeps it on the HUNT list but does not satisfy the name-level §7 present-inflection the buy-bar demands. Empty book = no overlap/concentration, no quota pressure; better to hold cash. Revises prior 06-06 comparable/BUY (a relative-batch read; SENS alone this week against the absolute exemplar). No watchlist — re-enters via a later scan if twiist/AID converts to disclosed units.

Marginal asymmetry on a dilution-taxed path: burns ~$128M/yr to make ~$62M rev, $300M shelf/$100M ATM loaded with only ~4 quarters runway — serial-dilution refi the macro posture cautions against; per-share 4x not high-confidence and no downside protection.
